obligation: A risk management system shall be established, implemented, documented and maintained for high-risk AI systems
The RMS shall be a continuous iterative process run across the entire lifecycle, with regular systematic review and updating
verification_logic: retraining_documentation.json OR regression_testing_record.json contains >=1 event with non-null {event_date, trigger, outcome}

obligation: Identify and analyse known and reasonably foreseeable risks to health, safety and fundamental rights under intended use
verification_logic: Every row has non-null {risk_id, hazard, affected_dimension, intended_use_context}; affected_dimension IN {health, safety, fundamental_rights}

obligation: Estimate and evaluate risks under intended use and reasonably foreseeable misuse
verification_logic: Every risk row has non-null {likelihood, severity}; AND threat_model.json OR misuse_scenario_analysis.json has >=1 non-null {misuse_scenario}; AND (SEMANTIC) each {harm} description supports its claimed {severity}

obligation: Evaluate other risks arising from post-market monitoring data
Adopt appropriate and targeted risk management measures addressing the risks identified under 2(a)
verification_logic: Every {risk_id} in clinical_risk_register.csv appears as {linked_risk_id} in >=1 row of mitigation_tracker.csv

obligation: Risks addressed shall concern only those reasonably mitigable or eliminable through design, development, or technical information
verification_logic: Every risk with a mitigation link has {mitigable = true}; risks with {mitigable = false} require no mitigation link

obligation: Risk management measures shall consider combined-requirement effects and interactions to minimise risk with appropriate balance
verification_logic: Every {mitigation_id} in mitigation_tracker.csv appears in traceability_matrix.csv linked to >=1 requirement

obligation: Residual risk per hazard and overall residual risk shall be judged acceptable
verification_logic: Every row has non-null {residual_risk, acceptability}; acceptability IN {acceptable, not_acceptable}

obligation: Eliminate or reduce risks through adequate design and development as far as technically feasible
verification_logic: For every mitigation with {hierarchy_level = 1}, the {description} semantically entails elimination or reduction by design

obligation: Implement adequate mitigation and control measures for risks that cannot be eliminated
verification_logic: For every mitigation with {hierarchy_level = 2}, the {description} semantically entails mitigation or control of a non-eliminable risk

obligation: Provide information and, where appropriate, training to deployers
verification_logic: For every mitigation with {hierarchy_level = 3}, the {description} semantically entails provision of information or training to deployers

obligation: Test high-risk AI systems to identify the most appropriate risk management measures and ensure consistent performance and compliance
verification_logic: validation_protocol.pdf present AND (clinical_validation_study.csv OR validation_test_results.json) contains >=1 test result row

obligation: Testing procedures may include testing in real-world conditions
verification_logic: IF any test record has {real_world = true} THEN validation_protocol.pdf references real-world conditions; ELSE not applicable

obligation: Testing shall be performed throughout development and before placing on market or service, against prior-defined metrics and probabilistic thresholds
verification_logic: Every {metric_name} in validation_test_results.json has a matching {metric_name, threshold} defined in validation_protocol.pdf and records {measured_value, pass_fail}

obligation: Consider whether the system may adversely impact persons under 18 and other vulnerable groups
verification_logic: clinical_risk_register.csv has >=1 row with {affected_group IN (under_18, vulnerable)} OR system_documentation.pdf {intended_purpose} states such groups out of scope

obligation: Where subject to other Union-law risk processes, paragraphs 1 to 9 may be combined with those procedures
verification_logic: Not independently verified; node retained for traceability
